title: Senior Business Systems Analyst
description:
PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new innovation center. We’re building a future that helps people live better lives longer – and we’re looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it.

Here, you’ll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security.

**A PURPOSE DRIVEN COMPANY – 150 YEARS**

While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you’ll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1.334 trillion in assets, we’re a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager.

At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you’ll find high-performance culture that’s flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable – always focused on delivering for our customers. It’s the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive.

Whether you’re just starting out or ready to take your next step, we’ll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career.

**What you will do:**

As a Lead, Business Systems Analyst on the Financial Risk Technology (Summit/Calypso) team, you will report to the Lead, Software Engineer (Financial Risk Technology) and partner with product owners, tech leads, designers, engineers and delivery professionals to drive quality assurance (QA) testing. You will act as the primary interface between Technology and specific business areas, identifying business requirements, creating project and process specifications, and coordinating with project teams. You will ensure projects stay on schedule and within budget while helping solve complex business problems and deliver innovative products, services, and experiences to delight our customers!

**What you can expect:**
------------------------

* Support the Lead, Software Engineer setting ambitious and clear product vision, and communicating ‘the story’ effectively to key stakeholders and the rest of the team; begin to identify opportunities to provide input to the team and coach others with occasional guidance
* Collaborate with product owners in understanding needs and defining feature stories, tech leads in defining technical design and other team members to understand the system end-to-end and deliver robust solutions that bring about business impact
* Work on extremely complex problems in which analysis of situations or data requires an evaluation of often complex variables related to technology and/or data; exercise independent judgment in developing methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results.
* Own the end-to-end product strategy from inception and determine business value once solution enters production
* Ensure alignment of product features and stories (i.e., review, give feedback, and prioritize user stories in line with product vision)
* Understand the vision and own aspects of product management / roadmap activities
* Use programming languages including but not limited to SQL, Oracle SQL, Test Management Tools, Agile, SDLC, Git and GitHub, Jira (Basics), and Microsoft Tools

**The skills and expertise you will bring:**
--------------------------------------------

* Bachelor of Computer Science or Engineering; Analytics or experience in related fields
* 5-7 years of experience in Calypso Application testing in critical modules including Collateral, Pricing Difference, UFT, VBScript, and API testing (SOAP & REST); experience in Functional and Regression testing with hands-on experience in the QFrame automation framework
* Experience with agile development methodologies and Test-Driven Development (TDD)
* Knowledge of business concepts, tools and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business
* Ability to learn new skills and knowledge on an on-going basis through self-initiative and tackling challenges
* Excellent problem solving, communication and collaboration skills
* Applied experience and/or expertise with several of the following:

o **Project/Product Management**: Planning, Progress Monitoring and Status Reporting, including visualization of works; Scaling Agile – Organizing, synchronizing multiple teams setup Estimations, ROI, project lifecycle

o **Effective Communication**: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. Ability to facilitate dialogue at the right level of detail for all members of the Agile team

o **Decision-Making & Critical Thinking**: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment

o **Business Acumen**: Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business; ability to apply this knowledge appropriately to diverse situations

o **Interpersonal Relationships**: Knowledge of the techniques and the ability to work with a variety of individuals and groups in a constructive and collaborative manner. Ability to work seamlessly with business partners and software developers alike in a liaison role

o **Financial Acumen**: Knowledge of financial concepts, tools and processes and how financial metrics are used to monitor and drive outcomes. Includes understanding of company accounts/metrics (ex: balance sheet, profit/loss, cash flow, budget & forecast)

o **Analytical** Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems

* **PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.**

**Skills:** SQL , Agile Methodologies , Business Analysis

title: Analyst II
description:

As a global leader in gaming content and technology, we nurture a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. Joining our team means you'll be part of an ambitious and encouraging environment where your contributions make a significant impact. If you're passionate about technology and eager to work in a dynamic industry, this is the opportunity you've been waiting for!

* A strong desire to learn and an eagerness to grow.

* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

title: Senior Analyst - Data Integration
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Role purposeThe Senior Data Analyst owns the integration, quality and analysis of energy, utility and smart-building data across JLL's JouLLe platform and connected systems. The role turns large, complex datasets into reliable reporting, tariff and budget insight, and process improvements that support our clients' energy and sustainability performance. It combines hands-on data work with project delivery, vendor collaboration and stakeholder engagement, and sits at the intersection of data, technology and sustainability within the JBS business.
  
  
Key responsibilitiesIntegrate smart-building and IoT solutions, API connectors and data feeds into JLL's energy management and sustainability platform (JouLLe), ensuring reliable, timely data flows.
  
Own data quality end to end - data cleansing, migration, integration, QA checks and validation across structured and unstructured energy and utility datasets.
  
Manage organizational structures within the JouLLe platform, including buildings (blocks), floors, tenants, and meter assignments across different client sites.
  
Produce utility consumption analysis and reporting for internal teams and clients, translating raw data into clear, decision-ready insight.
  
Conduct analytical reviews of energy data patterns to support optimization recommendations and identify anomalies.
  
Manage utility budget reporting and develop tariff optimisation strategies that reduce cost and improve energy performance.
  
Lead requirements gathering, process mapping and system implementation — including platform enhancements and interfaces to finance, accounting and CRM systems.
  
Manage and collaborate with platform and smart-building solution vendors on scoping, delivery and ongoing improvements.
  
Deliver data and platform projects end to end, on time and to specification.
  
Generate and manage client dashboard access via secure links, and provide platform training and reporting to clients and internal stakeholders on a regular basis.
  
Support compliance and quality audits, and drive process streamlining, automation and efficiency initiatives.
  
  
Essential skills & experienceSignificant experience (typically 3-5 years) in data analysis, integration and migration - ideally across energy, sustainability, utilities, property or finance.
  
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data patterns
  
Advanced Microsoft Excel, including Power Query, for handling large structured and unstructured datasets.
  
Experience with system implementation, administration and analysis.
  
Ticketing system or issue tracking tool experience (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow, or similar) for managing workflows and contractor coordination.
  
Strong stakeholder and vendor management, with clear written and verbal communication.
  
Project management capability, from requirements through to delivery.
  
Methodical, proactive and independently motivated, with high standards for data quality and accuracy.
  
  
Desirable skills & experienceExperience with energy management, utility billing or consumption platforms.
  
Experience with API based data flows, edge devices, IoT systems or building management systems (BMS)
  
Smart building / IoT data / API Connector experience.
  
Working knowledge of tariffs, utility budgeting and energy procurement.
  
ERP experience (e.g. Yardi Voyager or a comparable property ERP).
  
Exposure to CRM (Salesforce).
  
Relevant certifications in data analytics.
  
A proven track record of process improvement, automation and efficiency gains.
  
  
Technical toolset (familiarity valued)MS Office 365
  
Excel & Power Query
  
Energy management & utility billing platforms
  
Smart-building / IoT data
  
Ticketing/Issue-tracking systems
  
Salesforce
  
SharePoint / Teams
  
  
QualificationsDegree in a relevant discipline (Data / IT, engineering, finance or sustainability), or equivalent practical experience.
  
Data analytics or data-foundations certification desirable.
  
  
Personal attributesMethodical, proactive and detail-oriented, with a quality-first mindset.
  
Curious and a continuous learner - comfortable exploring new tools and solutions.
  
A collaborative team player who values transparent communication.
  
Comfortable working across multiple teams, systems and, where relevant, jurisdictions.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Senior Analyst – Investment Consulting
description:
**Introduction**  

Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.

  
**Overview**

The Investment Analyst will support the Global CIO Office in developing investment insights, maintaining analytical materials, coordinating governance processes, and delivering high-quality content to internal stakeholders and clients. The role is designed for an early-career investment professional who combines strong quantitative and research skills with strong communication. The analyst will help translate market, portfolio, manager, and business information into clear materials that support investment thought leadership across Gallagher.

  
  
**How you'll make an impact**

**Responsibilities:**

**Investment Research and Analysis**

* Conduct research on capital markets, asset classes, investment strategies, portfolio themes, and emerging investment issues.
* Collect, organize, and analyze quantitative and qualitative information from internal and external sources including performance, risk, exposure, and peer data.
* Prepare concise summaries of research findings, highlighting key facts, assumptions, implications, and areas requiring further review.
* Monitor relevant market developments and maintain recurring investment dashboards, exhibits, and briefing materials.

**Global CIO Office Support**

* Support the preparation of meeting materials, agendas, briefing notes, presentations, and follow-up items for investment leadership and governance forums.
* Coordinate inputs from manager research, strategic asset allocation, quantitative modeling, mission-driven investing, and other investment teams.
* Assist with special projects that advance the Global Investment Centre operating model and global investment proposition.
* Help document processes and maintain an organized repository of approved investment materials, decisions, and supporting analysis.

**Investment Governance and Quality Control**

* Assist with the administration of investment committee and governance processes, including scheduling, materials collation, action tracking, and recordkeeping.
* Complete data checks, source validation, proofreading, and version control before materials are circulated.
* Apply established templates, policies, and review standards to promote consistency across investment communications.
* Handle confidential information with appropriate care and follow applicable compliance, data, and records-management requirements.

**Communication and Content Development**

* Draft and edit presentations, market updates, investment commentary, research summaries, and internal communications.
* Convert complex investment concepts and analysis into clear, audience-appropriate messages and visuals.
* Partner with colleagues across regions and functions to gather inputs and produce consistent global materials.
* Support the preparation of selected client- and business-development materials under the direction of senior team members.
* Develop and maintain close relationship with the Investment & Retirement team.

  
  
**About you**

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum Required Degree: Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, mathematics, statistics, accounting, business, or a related discipline.
* Preferred Degree: Masters in Finance/Maths/ /Economics/Commerce

**Certificate(s)/Special Training:**

* Pursuing Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) designation an asset
* Experience on Advanced Excel skills and VBA

**Experience (Career Level Guide) :**

* Minimum 2-6 Years

**Knowledge, Skills and Ability:**

**Required:**

* Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, mathematics, statistics, accounting, business, or a related discipline.
* Up to two years of relevant internship or professional experience in investments, asset management, consulting, financial services, research, or analytics.
* Strong analytical and numerical skills, with the ability to interpret data and identify inconsistencies.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments, meet deadlines, and work effectively in a collaborative environment.
* Professional judgment and discretion when handling confidential or sensitive information.

**Desired:**

* Coursework or experience in investments, capital markets, portfolio analysis, statistics, or programming/data visualization.
* Progress toward, or interest in pursuing, a relevant professional qualification such as the CFA designation.
* Experience preparing executive-level presentations or synthesizing research for varied audiences.
* Familiarity with investment databases, performance analytics, market data platforms, or business-intelligence tools.
* Interest in global markets and in working across geographic and functional teams.

**Work Traits:**

* Communicates clearly, concisely, and professionally with colleagues and stakeholders.
* Approaches analysis with curiosity, discipline, and healthy skepticism while maintaining sight of broader business and client objectives.
* Takes ownership of assignments, prioritizes effectively, and follows through reliably.
* Produces accurate, well-supported, and carefully documented work using approved data, methodologies, and practices.
* Works independently within defined parameters, asks thoughtful questions, and incorporates feedback quickly.
* Communicates early when constraints arise and remains flexible in supporting recurring, ad hoc, and cross-functional needs.
* Maintains confidentiality and demonstrates sound professional judgment and a strong client-service mindset.
* Build strong relationships across the organization, actively develop technical expertise through feedback, and take ownership of providing collaborative, flexible support for Global CIO Office.

  
  
**Additional Information**

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being
* Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
* A collaborative, people-first culture with accessible leadership
* The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact

**At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace.** If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles.

*Gallagher is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

title: Senior Analyst, Financial Planning & Analysis
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Senior Analyst, Financial Planning & AnalysisSenior Analyst, Revenue Assurance, Financial Planning and Analysis  
  
About Mastercard?  
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.  
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.  
The Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) function manages all aspects of management reporting encompassing budgeting and forecasting, strategic and customer planning. This includes the management and execution of the corporate reporting and planning requirements.  
Business Finance Centre provides FP&A expertise to the organization by compiling and analysing metrics, identifying trends and problems, communicating information to relevant groups, and recommending actions to improve financial performance.  
  
Revenue Assurance (RA) is a function within Finance responsible for strengthening revenue controls, identifying billing opportunities, and minimizing revenue leakage across QMR (Quarterly Mastercard Reported), global billing processes, and billing reviews of revenue streams across core and services.  
The role focuses on ensuring billing accuracy, driving revenue recovery, and partnering with cross-functional teams to enhance revenue integrity and controls.  
  
This position will report to Director, Revenue Assurance, and is responsible for driving data analytics excellence for Global Corporate Revenue assurance team.
  
  
Roles and Responsibilities  

* Lead and own revenue assurance review projects to identify billing leakages and ensure billing completeness and accuracy.
* Working with billing on understanding rules, determining if there are any billing issues, working through the back billing, and working through system fixes
* Perform in-depth analysis of data systems and process flows to identify and resolve root causes of revenue leakage. Conduct rigorous data analysis from Mastercard databases to identify, research, and resolve revenue leakage; synthesize findings into actional insights and recommendations
* Understand and validate billing logic by recreating billing from core systems and comparing it with actual billed amounts.
* To work with the pricing teams to see any gaps in pricing or understanding the intent of pricing to determine if we are billing on what we intended to bill on.
* Support risk-based prioritization plans for revenue stream reviews based on materiality, business inputs, and new initiatives
* Perform financial analysis to estimate revenue impact at customer and country levels and support recovery decisions.
* Collaborate with Finance, Product, and GBSC teams to improve billing accuracy, implement fixes, and execute back-billing.
* Communicate identified revenue leakage opportunities, recovery actions/waivers to Regional Finance team and senior stakeholders.
* Act as an active member for all billing related matters and ensure alignment with corporate Revenue Assurance strategies.
* Partner cross-functionally with internal stakeholders such as Finance, Product, GBSC, etc., to develop analytical toolkit that drives efficiency on issue detection for key initiatives and focuses across corporate and regions
* Partner cross-functionally with internal stakeholders such as Finance, Product, GBSC, etc., to develop analytical toolkit that drives efficiency on issue detection for key initiatives and focuses across corporate and regions

  
All about you:  

* CA/MBA (Finance preferred); CPA/CFA certification is an added advantage.

Strong proficiency in database management, Microsoft Office applications, and data analytics.
  

* Demonstrated success in Revenue Assurance, with the ability to thrive in project-based roles requiring self-initiative and self-motivation.
* Excellent analytical and communication skills, with the ability to simplify and articulate complex issues effectively.
* Knowledge on tools like Alteryx, Tableau , Hyperion etc.
* Structured, proactive problem-solver with a strong focus on process improvement and execution.
* High degree of ownership, business acumen, and entrepreneurial mindset.
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across teams and all management levels.
* Proven ability to manage time-sensitive matters, ensuring timely follow-up and closure.
* Capable of handling multiple priorities simultaneously while working effectively with cross-functional partners.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Analyst - Tech Ops Business Intelligence
description:
Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.  
  
Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.  

**Description**
---------------

At United, we have some of the best aircraft in the world. Our Technical Operations team is full of aircraft maintenance technicians, engineers, planners, ground equipment and facilities professionals, and supply chain teams that help make sure they’re well taken care of and ready to get our customers to their desired destinations. If you’re ready to work on our planes, join our Tech Ops experts and help keep our fleet in tip-top shape.

**Job Overview and Responsibilities**

United's Maintenance & Engineering operation collects mountains of data, including maintenance plans, log pages, task sign-offs, schedule reliability performance, aircraft routing, part availability, and more. The Tech Ops Business Intelligence team will be tasked to deliver the right information to the right people in the right format at the right time, all with the goal of enabling better operational decisions that improve United's flight completion rate, on-time performance, productivity, and cost. This includes both performance trends looking backward, real-time operational status, and expectations looking forward. The team has five core responsibilities: Data design and validation, Data analysis, KPI design, dashboard creation, and automation.

* Support with design of meaningful metrics that indicate operational health and inform operational decisions
* Generate high-quality operational dashboards and reports for Tech Ops leadership, front-line management, and individual business teams throughout the organization
* Curate tables and views that serve as the "single source of truth" for United's Tech Ops data
* Continuously interface with business groups throughout Tech Ops to understand organizational needs and design solutions
* Support with automating existing manual reports and processes to improve operational throughput
* Document the Tech Ops data landscape, maintain an inventory of reports, and plan for report consolidation, elimination, and/or improvement

**This position is offered on local terms and conditions. Expatriate assignments and sponsorship for employment visas, even on a time-limited visa status, will not be awarded. This position is for United Airlines Business Services Pvt. Ltd - a wholly owned subsidiary of United Airlines Inc.**

**Qualifications**
------------------

**What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):**

  

* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field like Math, Statistics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field required
* At least 2 years of experience in analytics/ reporting required
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy
* Understanding of data structures, relationships, and efficient transformations
* Knowledge and application of data visualization best practices
* Familiarity with writing complex queries and procedures using both traditional and modern technologies/languages (i.e. SQL, Python, Spark, etc.)
* Data visualization skills using one or more reporting tools (i.e. Spotfire, Tableau, ggplot2, etc.) to produce meaningful, elegant dashboards

The Lead Research Analyst will support the Alternative Investments and Manager Research teams by performing investment data analysis, due diligence support, reporting, and operational research activities across both private and liquid alternative investment offerings.
